title: Turn a product need into a prediction contract
description: Choose a use case, task family, and feature boundary. The lab checks whether the model output can be learned without future information and used by the product.

families.label: Classification
families.detail: Predict a category or the probability of a category.

families.label: Ranking
families.detail: Order candidates by expected relevance or utility.

featurePolicies.label: Small request-time set
featurePolicies.detail: Use a few stable signals known when the decision is made.

featurePolicies.label: Full request-time set
featurePolicies.detail: Use validated signals that are all available before the action.

featurePolicies.label: Include a future outcome
featurePolicies.detail: Accidentally include a field produced after the prediction is needed.

scenarios.label: Delivery ETA
scenarios.need: Give a customer a useful arrival estimate when checkout completes.
scenarios.action: Show an ETA and escalate orders at risk of missing the promise.
scenarios.mistake: A late-biased ETA erodes trust; an early-biased ETA creates avoidable support load.

scenarios.label: Fraud review
scenarios.need: Decide which payment attempts should enter manual review.
scenarios.action: Route high-risk attempts to review while allowing low-risk purchases.
scenarios.mistake: False positives block legitimate buyers; false negatives admit fraud.

scenarios.label: Search results
scenarios.need: Place the most useful documents near the top of a result page.
scenarios.target: Expected relevance for the current query
scenarios.action: Order eligible documents before rendering the page.
scenarios.labelSource: Reviewed relevance judgments plus corrected interaction data
scenarios.mistake: Weak top positions waste attention even when relevant documents exist lower down.
